batch.description: Jahangirnagar University A Unit (গাণিতিক ও পদার্থ বিষয়ক অনুষদ — Faculty of Mathematical & Physical Sciences), academic session 2012-2013, printed SET CODE: 3/4 — full 60-question paper transcribed by direct visual reading of the solved-paper compilation PDF distributed via AdmissionWar/Google Drive (file ju-a-2012-2013-set2.pdf; ⚠ LISTING-VS-PRINTED MISMATCH: the Drive listing labels this file 'Set-2' but the paper's own printed header reads SET CODE: 3/4, and the printed header governs — the sibling file listed 'Set-1' likewise prints the merged pair code 1/2). The compilation prints the questions in the paper's own numeric order 1-60: Bangla Q1-3 and English Q4-6 (boxed 'Ans: X' tags on Q1-3 only), Higher Mathematics Q7-23 (each with a 'Solve:' worked solution ending in a boxed 'Ans: X' tag), ICT Q24, Chemistry Q25-42 (a printed 'রসায়ন' heading stands above Q25 — the compilation's only subject heading; several questions carry a short ব্যাখ্যা), and Physics Q43-60 ('Solve:' boxes, several with a data panel). 51 questions are keyed, 9 are keyless (Q4, Q5, Q6, Q22, Q26, Q35, Q39, Q43, Q50 — Q35's box prints 'Ans:' with no letter, and Q22's/Q50's printed Solve results match no option), there are no dual keys and no printed no-correct-option dispositions. Two boxed keys conflict with their own printed Solve (Q15: box D vs Solve 9/2; Q54: box D vs Solve √2) and are preserved as printed. EXTRACTION STAGE: all questions are content-UNVERIFIED and all keyed answers answer-UNVERIFIED — the printed compiler keys are preserved as-is and are NOT official university keys (JU publishes no official past papers). Transcription preserves printed wording, option order and errors; Solve/ব্যাখ্যা workings are not transcribed except where a note cites them. IMPORT-READY SUBSET after cross-source adjudication vs Satt Academy: 5 of 60 questions verified. row 1: excluded (DIFFER) row 3: excluded (DIFFER) row 4: key taken from Satt (d) row 5: excluded (DIFFER) row 6: excluded (DIFFER) row 9: excluded (NOT_PUBLIC) row 10: excluded (NOT_PUBLIC) row 11: excluded (NOT_PUBLIC) row 12: excluded (NOT_PUBLIC) row 13: excluded (NOT_PUBLIC) row 14: excluded (NOT_PUBLIC) row 15: excluded (NOT_PUBLIC) row 16: excluded (NOT_PUBLIC) row 17: excluded (NOT_PUBLIC) row 18: excluded (NOT_PUBLIC) row 19: excluded (NOT_PUBLIC) row 20: excluded (NOT_PUBLIC) row 21: excluded (NOT_PUBLIC) row 22: excluded (NOT_PUBLIC) row 23: excluded (NOT_PUBLIC) row 24: excluded (NOT_PUBLIC) row 25: excluded (DIFFER) row 26: excluded (DIFFER) row 27: excluded (DIFFER) row 28: excluded (DIFFER) row 29: excluded (NOT_PUBLIC) row 30: excluded (NOT_PUBLIC) row 31: excluded (NOT_PUBLIC) row 32: excluded (DIFFER) row 33: excluded (NOT_PUBLIC) row 34: excluded (DIFFER) row 35: excluded (DIFFER) row 36: excluded (DIFFER) row 37: excluded (NOT_PUBLIC) row 38: excluded (NOT_PUBLIC) row 39: excluded (NOT_PUBLIC) row 40: excluded (NOT_PUBLIC) row 41: excluded (NOT_PUBLIC) row 42: excluded (DIFFER) row 43: excluded (NOT_PUBLIC) row 44: excluded (NOT_PUBLIC) row 45: excluded (NOT_PUBLIC) row 46: excluded (NOT_PUBLIC) row 47: excluded (NOT_PUBLIC) row 48: excluded (NOT_PUBLIC) row 49: excluded (NOT_PUBLIC) row 50: excluded (NOT_PUBLIC) row 51: excluded (NOT_PUBLIC) row 52: key conflict - Satt key (b) recorded, answer unverified row 53: excluded (NOT_PUBLIC) row 54: excluded (NOT_PUBLIC) row 55: excluded (DIFFER) row 56: excluded (NOT_PUBLIC) row 57: excluded (NOT_PUBLIC) row 58: excluded (NOT_PUBLIC) row 59: excluded (NOT_PUBLIC) row 60: excluded (NOT_PUBLIC)

sourceDocuments.title: JU A Unit admission test 2012-2013, printed SET CODE: 3/4 — solved-paper compilation (AdmissionWar / Google Drive PDF, file listed as 'Set-2')
sourceDocuments.notes: Scanned solved-paper compilation, 6 pp., CamScanner scans carrying AdmissionWar overlays (red 'Download More Question Bank From www.admissionwar.com' header, 'Get All University Admission Update From www.admissionwar.com' footer, diagonal ADMISSION WAR watermark logo, heaviest over pp.1-2). Paper header (PDF p.1) confirmed visually before transcription: A ইউনিট, গাণিতিক ও পদার্থ বিষয়ক অনুষদ, জাহাঙ্গীরনগর বিশ্ববিদ্যালয়, ১ম বর্ষ স্নাতক (সম্মান) ভর্তি পরীক্ষা ২০১২-২০১৩, মোট নম্বরঃ ৬০, সময়ঃ ১ ঘণ্টা, boxed SET CODE: 3/4. A circled handwritten '16' at the left of p.1 is a candidate's mark, not print. Transcription by direct visual reading of the on-disk 300-dpi page renders (ocr/pages/ju1213as2/, 5166x7310 px; p-1 render sha256 db3bdb7393af8372fa83f353804bec2b92672572f118daa29f93928145bf0275); watermark-obscured text and key boxes were read on zoomed crops, including per-pixel min-channel and single-channel crops that suppress the orange/blue watermark. The renders for pp.2 and 6 were still being written when the session began and were used only after they loaded completely and stabilised.

examRules.sourceNote: Paper header (PDF p.1) states: A ইউনিট, গাণিতিক ও পদার্থ বিষয়ক অনুষদ, জাহাঙ্গীরনগর বিশ্ববিদ্যালয়, ১ম বর্ষ স্নাতক (সম্মান) ভর্তি পরীক্ষা ২০১২-২০১৩, মোট নম্বরঃ ৬০, সময়ঃ ১ ঘণ্টা, boxed SET CODE: 3/4. Printed instructions (নির্দেশাবলীঃ): প্রশ্নপত্রে ৬০টি প্রশ্ন আছে। সকল প্রশ্নের উত্তর দিতে হবে। প্রতিটি ভুল উত্তরের জন্য ০.২০ নম্বর কাটা যাবে। নিচের 'ক' ও 'খ' বাক্য দুটি OMR উত্তরপত্রের নিচে 'ক' এবং 'খ' চিহ্নিত স্থানে লিখতে হবে। পরীক্ষা শেষে উত্তরপত্র (OMR) এর সাথে প্রশ্নপত্রও কর্তব্যরত সম্মানিত শিক্ষকের নিকট জমা দিতে হবে। (ক) যে সকলের বন্ধু সে কারই বন্ধু নয় (খ) A friend to all is a friend to none.
